summary: @ornikar/slate-react-fork preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle hook (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from a GitHub release URL, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to run a bundled ~727KB file named math_init.js. If a system `bun` binary is already present, that is used instead. math_init.js is a `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle whose body is a shuffled string-array with a rotation function (WV8StW), numeric-hex identifiers, and `with` statements consistent with obfuscator.io output — the payload is not human-readable and is only executable via the freshly downloaded Bun runtime. The filename and payload have no relation to the package's stated purpose (a Slate/React rich-text editor fork), and the README is copied verbatim from upstream Slate. The package publishes under the `@ornikar` npm scope but the declared repository points to an unrelated personal GitHub fork (github.com/CorentinAndre/slate), consistent with a scoped-namespace impersonation used to deliver the dropper. The alternate-runtime fetch-and-execute pattern grants the publisher install-time code execution on every machine that runs `npm install` against this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
